_comment: Hand-edited, not scraped. Site news: launches, discount codes, changes. Newest first. Set active:false to hide without deleting. `code` is optional and renders as a copyable promo chip.

announcements.title: Per-game leaderboards are live
announcements.body: Finish a run and you'll see where you land against everyone else, plus your percentile. Bankroll games rank on profit, so everyone starts from the same $100.

announcements.title: Job board added
announcements.body: Openings pulled straight from the firms' own boards, refreshed on demand. Filter by trading, research, engineering, risk or internships.
